gold: Branch retinal vein occlusion with preretinal neovascularization

selector.why: The evidence of hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels and angiogenic sprouts showing flow signals decided it.

support_spans: The patient was treated with 2 intravitreal anti–vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) injections
At 12 months: En face OCT revealed hyperreflective tissues starting to proliferate on retinal vessels
At 15 months: Hyperreflective tissues increased in size with angiogenic sprouts showing flow signals extending vertically
contradict_spans: At 3 months after presentation, her macular edema was completely resolved, without recurrence
